hotspots.name: Your Bed
hotspots.description: A narrow iron frame and a mattress that has given up arguing. It is yours until the rent says otherwise.

hotspots.name: The Desk
hotspots.description:
Your notes, in the hand of a man who was trained to cite his sources: dates down the left, a column for what you saw and a column for what you were told, and a rule between them because they are not the same thing.

Underneath, face down, the card the Club dealt you.

hotspots.name: The Window
hotspots.description: Whitlock Row, four floors down and going about its evening. The lamplighter comes at half six and is never late, which you find steadying in a way you would rather not examine.

hotspots.name: The Grate
hotspots.description: Coal is dearer than it was. You have been burning it in the evenings only, and telling yourself that is discipline rather than arithmetic.

hotspots.name: The Shelf
hotspots.description: Six books, four of them borrowed and two of them overdue. A history of the Intis wars, a grammar, and — pushed to the back where the light does not reach it — a slim thing with no title on the spine at all.

hotspots.name: The Clothes Press
hotspots.description: One good coat, brushed. One working coat, not. A hat you can be respectable in and a hat you can be forgotten in, which between them are most of what this trade requires.
